completed_iteration.user_outcome: Exact deterministic recoveries are executable in one call; choice-dependent repairs remain honest human requests; agent termination agrees with response sufficiency.
completed_iteration.tests: 2574 passed, 11 skipped in the full local suite; 82 focused tests passed; 6/6 serial RecoveryBench cases completed and all gates passed.
completed_iteration.remaining_risk: The benchmark is a representative boundary shard, and successful retry does not imply accuracy or support improvement.

active_iteration.user_hypothesis: Agents and humans should receive complete, resumable, honest results under interruptions and bounded resource pressure, with typed failures instead of partial artifacts, hangs, or duplicated work.
must_not_regress: canonical outputs and evidence are identical after safe resume
partial writes never appear as completed artifacts
timeouts, worker failures, and unavailable optional models are typed
bounded retries cannot loop or duplicate external work
serial and low-resource operation remain supported
admission precision, support tiers, and automation authority remain exact
active_iteration.next_action: Audit existing crash-safe benchmark runners, artifact writes, cache/resume identities, timeout handling, and worker failure boundaries; freeze a small deterministic fault-injection probe before changing production code.
